Author: XivHub
Name: AutoPincher
Punchline: One-click undercut of every retainer listing, fully local.
Description: Repinches your retainer market listings by undercutting the cheapest live competitor by 1 gil. Reads each listing straight from game memory, clicks the in-game market board's Compare Prices to find the current cheapest offering, and sets your asking price to one below it. Your own retainers and housing mannequins are never treated as competitors, so two retainers selling the same item don't chase each other down. No server, no telemetry, nothing leaves your client. Adds an Auto Pinch button next to AutoRetainer's retainer-list controls and a /autopinch command for the open retainer. AutoRetainer is optional (used only to pause its automation during a pinch run).
